{{Quote|SWe'll need to help Sulale with repairs before returning back to the Nova Orion. Hurry as fast as ya can.|[[Aleas Rans'ery]], to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:KBR" />}}
'''Sulale Kallor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sulale and his brother [[Waris Kallor|Sulale]] were veteran [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] pilots.<ref name="SWG:KBR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> they were stationed in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] and flew [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]]. During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], the Kallor brothers were tasked by [[Aleas Rans'ery]] to scout enemy territory and find weaknesses in the [[Salient Trinity]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] bases. The brothers succeed in their mission but were attacked by Black Sun starfighters in the [[Bright Jewel Ribbon]]. Waris Kallor's ship was captured while Sulale managed to hyperspace out the area. Waris was finally rescued by Car'das starfighters dispatched by Rans'ery and returned to [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]. Car'das pilots then headed to Sulale Kallor's damaged ship and defended the Z-95 while Sulale performed repairs. Sulale Kallor finally returned to the [[Nova Orion Station]].<ref name="SWG:KBR" />
